name: Slider
purpose: Let a person pick one value from a range when the exact number matters less than where it sits.
description: A labelled slider with its value written above it and the range written under it.

label.description: What the field asks for. It names the control and, with no name prop, the key its value is sent under.

name.description: The key the value is sent under, such as "email". Left out, it is the label in camelCase: "Work email" is sent as workEmail.

min.description: Lowest value a person can choose.

max.description: Highest value a person can choose.

step.description: Distance between values a person can choose.

value.description: Where the slider starts. Defaults to min.

unit.description: Unit written with every figure: "$" leads it; "%" and words such as "seats" follow it.

hint.description: Help that stays under the field and is read with it, such as a format or a limit.
